_doc: The money lane (assistant/scripts/money/). Everything an organization tunes lives here; the code only interprets it. READ-ONLY on every bank: the lane never pays, transfers or enters credentials. Rulings 14-15 in assistant/TRACKING_DESIGN.md. Tax tables are the owner's responsibility to re-check every January (sources noted per block). feeds: one block per bank-feed adapter (simplefin.py, plaid.py), every one read-only.

feeds._doc: SimpleFIN Bridge (https://beta-bridge.simplefin.org, $15/yr, link banks on their site, a read-only access URL here). Relay is NOT reachable through SimpleFIN (Relay supports Plaid only, 2026-10-15): that is the plaid row below.

Plaid, for Relay (Operating / Tax / Savings). READ-ONLY: plaid.py allows only /accounts/balance/get and /transactions/sync, plus /link/token/create and /item/public_token/exchange inside the one-time Link flow (the owner signs in to the bank in Plaid's own window; nothing is typed here). Keys from dashboard.plaid.com (free Trial / Limited Production tier) via setup_creds.py money plaid. env: production | sandbox. redirect_uri only if the bank needs OAuth: register http://localhost:<link_port>/ under Team Settings > API in the Plaid dashboard and put it here. days_requested = history asked for at Link time (max 730).

accounts._doc: How an account's NAME maps to a kind. Relay names its buckets ('Operating', 'Tax', 'Savings'); a personal checking or card falls through to 'personal'. kinds: operating | tax | savings | personal | card | unknown. side = whose money it is for the readback.

overrides._doc: account id -> kind/side when the name is ambiguous. Filled from the weekly unknowns answers or by hand.

relay._doc: Relay auto-splits every deposit into buckets by percentage (the owner, 2026-10-15). null = not confirmed yet; the set-aside card then only states the estimate. Report only: the lane never moves money.

quarterly._doc: Estimated-tax checkpoints. federal shares are 25% each; CA front-loads 30/40/0/30 (FTB). Due dates roll to the next business day in real life; T-10d reminders make that moot. method: 'annualize' projects YTD profit over the full year; 'ytd' taxes only what has landed.

tax_tables._doc: Single filer. Federal 2026 from Rev. Proc. 2025-32 (Oct 2025). California: 2025 tables (FTB publishes the next year's in late summer; re-check). Brackets are [upper_bound, rate]; the last upper bound is null.
